name: Sea Battle
shortDescription: Hide your fleet, guess where the enemy ships are, and sink them all first.
rules:
Each side has a 10 × 10 sea and 5 ships: **Carrier** (5 squares), **Battleship** (4), **Cruiser** (3), **Submarine** (3) and **Destroyer** (2).

At the start, each side secretly places its ships in straight lines, across or down, without overlapping (touching is fine). Your opponent cannot see your ships.

On your turn, pick a square in the enemy sea and fire. A **hit** earns **another shot**; a **miss** passes the turn.

When every square of a ship has been hit, it **sinks** and is shown to both sides.

The first to sink the whole enemy fleet wins.

place.title: Place your fleet
place.hint: Pick a ship, then tap the sea to place it. Tap a placed ship to pick it up.

yourTurn: Pick a square in the enemy sea to fire at.

handoff.title: Pass the device to {player}
handoff.text: No peeking, other player! Press the button when ready.
